Hail and Weather Protection: While Class 4 shingles resist standard hail up to about 2.5 inches, extreme or larger stones can still cause structural damage.

Insurance Discounts: Many homeowners insurance companies in Utah offer annual premium discounts (often ranging from 5% to 25% or more) if you install an UL 2218 Class 4-rated roof. Check directly with your insurance provider before buying .

Building Codes & Materials: Utah building codes regulate roof assemblies and testing standards (such as ASTM D3161 for wind/slate compliance), and SBS-modified or reinforced architectural laminate shingles are widely stocked by regional suppliers like All Roofing Supply .
